title: Puls Sync Protocol v1: shared definitions
description: Reusable building blocks referenced by every other schema in this directory. Nothing validates against this file directly.

epochMs.description: Milliseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z as a JSON number, possibly fractional, within 0001-01-01 to 9999-12-31T23:59:59.999Z.

requiredEpochMs.description: An epochMs that must be present and non-zero: the reference server treats 0 as absent and rejects the line.

typeIdentifier.description: A HealthKit type identifier, e.g. HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeartRate, or one of the protocol's synthetic identifiers (HKWorkoutTypeIdentifier, HKActivitySummaryTypeIdentifier).

temporalContext.description: The time zone in force when the instant it accompanies was observed. The instant itself stays UTC; this lets a receiver reconstruct local wall time.

source.description: How the zone was determined. The app sends device_current.

tzdbVersion.description: IANA tz database release, or empty when unknown.

metadata.description: HKObject.metadata coerced to JSON scalars. Dates arrive as epochMs numbers and HKQuantity values as plain numbers, so a receiver cannot tell them from other numbers.
